android.desc:
**100% offline. Zero cloud. Complete privacy.**

Untether runs entirely on your devices — no servers, no accounts. Your notifications and voice stay between your phone and your watch.

Smart notifications and voice replies for your Garmin watch. Phone stays in bag.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SMART NOTIFICATIONS

See your notifications on your wrist with full message previews. WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, SMS, email — if it has a notification, Untether captures it.

• Full message content, not just "New message from..."
• Notification history stored on watch for offline viewing
• Reply directly from your watch

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

VOICE REPLIES

Reply to any notification using your voice. Tap reply on your watch, speak into your phone's microphone, and send. No tiny keyboard, no canned responses.

• High-accuracy speech-to-text via ML Kit
• Works with any app that supports notification replies
• Review and edit before sending

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PHONE STAYS IN BAG

Untether is designed for the "phone in bag" lifestyle. Your watch handles the quick checks and replies. Your phone handles the heavy lifting — from inside your bag, pocket, or across the room.

Perfect for:
• Running and cycling without stopping to check your phone
• Meetings where you need to stay informed but not distracted
• Any time you want to be present but connected

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRIVACY FIRST

• All processing happens on your device
• No cloud servers — your messages stay on your devices
• No account required
• No subscriptions — one-time purchase

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

REQUIREMENTS

• Garmin watch with Connect IQ support (Fenix 5+, Epix, Forerunner 945+, Venu, etc.)
• Untether watch app from the Connect IQ Store
• Android 8.0 or later

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GETTING STARTED

1. Install the Untether watch app from the Connect IQ Store
2. Install this companion app on your Android phone
3. Grant notification access and microphone permissions
4. Pair your watch and start using Untether

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PRICING

Free to try. $9.99 one-time purchase to unlock all features. No subscriptions, no hidden costs.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SUPPORT

Questions or feedback? Visit untether.watch or email support@untether.watch

quotes.text:
I'm a solo dev working on a suite of Garmin apps in order to make the sportswatch into a fully flung smartwatch, with the intent of enabling you to reduce screentime (mobile) but still maintain "essential functionality" and live in the modern world. The ecosystem is offline and privacy first - no cloud/servers.

The watches are chronically underpowered (great for battery life) and need a phone for internet anyway (inbuilt Sat/LTE is not available to devs) - so I've offloaded most of the heavy work to an Android (for now) companion app.

The key features:

- Use the phone mic (headphones or built-in) to dictate to the watch (on-board transcription) - the built-in keyboards are tough to use

- Reply to android notifications with voice (ie. WhatsApp/SMS)

- No extra costs for AI - you have a flagship mobile - all AI inference is on-device

- No internet access for watch or phone app - privacy first, local.

The apps:

- [Untether Comms](https://apps.garmin.com/apps/ac3c70e8-d631-49b9-a6f3-4335dc9b68b2) - Reply to notifications with voice

- [Untether Notes](https://apps.garmin.com/apps/3984f15b-0924-428a-895e-c4c97a2245a0) - Voice notes automatically transcribed onto the watch

- Untether AI (coming soon) - Chat with Gemini Nano (or others) about your health metrics or anything without your phone

- [Companion Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=watch.untether.android)

It is very much still in Beta and might be pretty unstable!
